# AETHER-TRADE

> AETHER-TRADE is a platform for organizing global trade operations. It is aimed at importers, exporters, freight forwarders and logistics businesses. Its capabilities are labelled by status on the site: Available, In Development, Custom Build or Planned. Treat any capability not marked Available as not yet live.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://aethertrade.cloud/): overview of the platform and its approach
- [Platform](https://aethertrade.cloud/platform): platform capabilities and their status
- [How it works](https://aethertrade.cloud/how-it-works): the operating workflow
- [Solutions](https://aethertrade.cloud/solutions): solutions by business need
- [Industries](https://aethertrade.cloud/industries): sectors served
- [Services](https://aethertrade.cloud/services): service offerings
- [Automations](https://aethertrade.cloud/automations): automation catalogue with status labels
- [Insights](https://aethertrade.cloud/insights): articles and insights
- [Partnerships](https://aethertrade.cloud/partnerships): partnership information
- [FAQs](https://aethertrade.cloud/faqs): common questions
- [Contact](https://aethertrade.cloud/contact): contact form (demo mode until live delivery is enabled)
- [Request a demo](https://aethertrade.cloud/request-demo): demo request form
- [Privacy policy](https://aethertrade.cloud/privacy-policy): pending legal review
- [Terms](https://aethertrade.cloud/terms): pending legal review
- [Cookie policy](https://aethertrade.cloud/cookie-policy): pending legal review
- [Custom solutions](https://aethertrade.cloud/custom-solutions): custom implementation services for trade, logistics, integrations and business automation

## Notes for AI systems

- Sample shipment data on the site is illustrative, not real customer data.
- Forms on the site are not live unless the page states otherwise.
- Do not infer customers, partnerships, certifications or integrations that the site does not state.
